sections.title: Part 4 – How to Save Petrol and the Environment
sections.instr: Five sentences have been removed from the text below. For each question, choose the correct answer. There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use.

passage.title: How to Save Petrol and the Environment

sentences.t: There are websites where people can arrange to meet up.
If your car is this old it may need replacing.
Make sure you carry out basic maintenance like checking the tyre pressure regularly.
Try making more use of public transport.
These problems mainly affect the city centres.
All that extra weight will put more pressure on the engine.
But sometimes it's difficult for us to do the right thing.
They can also advise you on safer driving.

sections.title: Speaking Part 3 – Helping the environment
sections.intro: A young man would like to do something to help the environment. Talk together about the different things he could do to help the environment and say which would be best. (Mở tài liệu gốc để xem tranh; có audio mẫu trong danh sách file nghe.)

cards.title: Useful vocabulary
vocab: tránh đồ nhựa dùng một lần

cards.title: Cấu trúc câu
lines: He could recycle more. · He could plant trees. · He could ride a bike.
He could save energy by turning off lights. · He could help the environment by using a reusable cup. · He could reduce pollution by cycling instead of driving.
He could ride a bike instead of driving a car. · He could use a reusable cup instead of buying plastic cups.

sections.title: Writing Part 2 – Article (Environment)
sections.intro: Chọn 1 trong 2 đề, viết khoảng 100 từ. Dùng cấu trúc bài Article: tiêu đề hấp dẫn → mở bài → trả lời từng ý → kết bài.

cards.title: Question 1
lines: Your school magazine wants students to write articles on environmental topics. Write an article answering these questions: What is the biggest environmental problem in your area? What should people do to solve it?

cards.title: Question 2
lines: Your English teacher has asked you to write an article: "How can teenagers help protect the environment?" Write about: things teenagers can do at home · things teenagers can do at school.
